title: Toudou-kun Chi no Maid Shota
titleNative: 凍堂くんちのメイドショタ
synopsis: Rennosuke, the scion of the influential Toudou Group, has a terrible relationship with his family. His father and older sister always scold him by saying things like "Did you get into a fight again?" and "Having a delinquent for a son of the Toudou family is such an embarrassment." One day, Rennosuke chances upon a hungry child. The sight of the child devouring a piece of bread reminds Rennosuke of the dog he once owned, and he asks half-jokingly "If you don't have anywhere to go, why don't you come with me?" The child willingly follows him to the Toudou house and starts working there as a maid. (Source: Natalie, translated)

title: Shuuen no Shiori
titleNative: 終焉の栞
synopsis: In a certain school, there exists a bloody history: 10 years ago, several students were brutally and mysteriously murdered. Rumor has it that it was the work of the "Book of Demise," a collection of urban legends and tall tales. Inside this book, it is said that the "Bookmark of Demise" turns the page it rests on into reality. Four rumor-loving friends—A-ya, an antisocial boy who relishes starting such rumors; B-ko, a popular girl who acts polite around others; C-ta, a level-headed boy who is A-ya's childhood friend; and D-ne, a quiet and introverted girl—at this school have discovered how to acquire the Book of Demise. Performing the ritual, they become part of the Demise Game—but realize too late that they are in over their heads. To escape this game, they must weed out a traitor among them. However, at the same time, the Bookmark of Demise is turning urban legend to reality, revealing an eerie connection to the events of 10 years ago and creating a living nightmare of lies and betrayal. (Source: MAL Rewrite)
